suggestion.topic: Python GIL Explained: Why Multi-Threading Lies to You
suggestion.rationale: Developers constantly hit performance bottlenecks in Python when multithreading fails to utilize multi-core CPUs due to the Global Interpreter Lock, making this one of the highest-intent searches in Python performance engineering.
suggestion.hook_angle: Your multi-threaded Python code is running on exactly ONE CPU core right now—here is why.
